ndkEvidence: libc++_shared.so in qualified-host.json (1304848 bytes, sha256 35e56d20...) is byte-identical to this NDK's aarch64 libc++_shared.so after llvm-strip --strip-unneeded; r25c and r28c give different bytes. scripts/build-embedding-host.mjs re-checks this before compiling.
engineRepositoryEvidence: vendor/eliza .gitmodules, submodule plugins/plugin-local-inference/native/llama.cpp; the commit is the gitlink recorded as forkPin in qualified-host.json.
remapBuildPathEvidence: the reviewed libraries in qualified-host.json were built without a build-path remap, so they embed the absolute directory they were built in (a build without the remap carries 183 such source paths in libelizainference.so and 5 in libelizavoicejni.so), and that directory is recorded only in the qualification receipt, which is not in this repository. Measured 2026-10-11 at elizaOS 13c98575987a with this NDK and CMake: a rebuild in another directory gave libelizainference.so 6208400 bytes against the reviewed 6199248 and libelizavoicejni.so 1016632 against 1016376, while libc++_shared.so matched
remapBuildPathMeaning: Set to true only in the commit that replaces qualified-host.json with libraries built by `node scripts/build-embedding-host.mjs --candidate` and qualified by a person. From then on `npm run agent:build-embedding-host` rebuilds and stages them on any machine.

unqualifiedCandidateMeasurement.note: NOT reviewed, NOT qualified and NOT staged by any script. Two --remap-build-path builds in different directories on one macOS arm64 host, 2026-10-11, were byte-identical to each other, and a third built by `node scripts/build-embedding-host.mjs --candidate` in another directory matched them.
